name: Princessfall
storyline:
A beautiful, blonde-haired debutante, born into privilege as the daughter of a noble house, but whose fortunes take a turn for the worse after her father’s untimely death...

Betrayed by her servants, stripped of her wealth, and saddled with crushing debt, she stands at the edge of ruin. Only the quick action of her one-armed butler, J, has spared her from her enemies’ grasp.

J remains by her side, guiding her through their new life together—and entrusting her with a pair of enchanted hand cannons known as Drive.

Armed with Drive and a renewed determination, Alice rises once more to defy her fate!

Will she reclaim her pride as a noble?

Or tumble headlong into darkness?

This fallen princess must now choose her path forward.
summary: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.
